name: deckhand
description: Control bar (usage 5h/fb/7d/ctx, model buttons O/F/S/H, Sub5 parallel sub agents, delegate buttons CL/CS/CA/CR/GF that hand a task to Codex, Cursor agent or agy read-only), deploy/PR watch with 3-strike auto-stop, Claude↔Codex handoff with git facts filled by program, attribution guard and localized agy translation.

pollSeconds.title: Deploy watch base interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: First poll interval; it doubles after each unchanged check (up to 5 minutes) and resets on change.

noProgressLimit.title: Stop after N identical results
noProgressLimit.description: Identical results in a row that make a watch a candidate for stopping, and the threshold of the Bash repeated-check guard (CLAUDE.md 3-strike rule). A watch never stops on fewer than 2.

stallMinutes.title: Minimum stall time before a watch stops (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A watch stops only after the identical-result limit is reached AND its status has not changed for this long, so one long CI step is not mistaken for a hang. 0 stops on the count alone.

sub5Max.title: Sub5: most items dispatched at once
sub5Max.description: The Sub5 button hands the most important items, at most this many (1 to 8), to sub agents at the same time.

sub5Model.title: Sub5: workers' model
sub5Model.description: Model the Sub5 workers run on (an alias, so it follows the latest of that family).

sub5Effort.title: Sub5: workers' effort
sub5Effort.description: Reasoning effort of the Sub5 workers. max is the highest.

usageWarnPercent.title: Usage warning threshold (%)
usageWarnPercent.description: Toast once when a rate-limit window crosses this percentage.

agyModel.title: agy model for translation
agyModel.description: Model passed to agy --model for the translate tool.
